JK Bank Apprentice Result 2026 Out @ibpsreg.ibps.in

The Jammu and Kashmir Bank (JK) Apprentice Result 2026 has been released for the recruitment advertised under Advertisement No. JKB/HR/Rectt/2026-182. The result contains the qualification status and scores of the candidates who have been provisionally selected for apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Candidates shortlisted in the written exam will be called for the next stage through their registered email ID. They must complete document verification and medical examination to confirm their final selection.

Jammu & Kashmir Bank Apprentice Result: Overview

The JK Bank Apprentice Exam was conducted on 31st May 2026 to recruit a total of 614 Apprentice Vacancy. The selection process includes a written exam followed by a DV and medical test. For more details check the table below.

Conducting Body Jammu & Kashmir Bank
Notification Number JKB/HR/Rectt/2026-182
Written Exam 31st May 2026
JK Bank Apprentice Result Date 1st August 2026
Last Date 30th August 2026
Result Status Released
Official Website www.jkb.bank.in

JK Bank Apprentice Result 2026 Download Link

The  JK Bank Apprentice Result 2026 Link has been activated by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection. The result contains the qualification and score card of the shortlisted candidates with category and state details. Candidates can download the PDF from the IBPS website. Those who achieve the cut off are considered qualified for the post. Click on the link below to download the result PDF.

JK Bank Apprentice Result 2026: Link Active

How to Download JK Bank Apprentice Result 2026?

The J&K Bank Apprentice Result 2026 is now available on the official website for candidates to check their scores. Follow the steps below to download it easily.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website website at ibpsreg.ibps.in/
  2. Go to the Career Notices or Recruitment section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the JK Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Result link.
  4. Enter your Roll Number and Date of Birth to log in.
  5. Your Jammu & Kashmir Apprentice Result 2026 will appear on the screen.
  6. Download the result PDF and take a printout for future use.

Details Mentioned in J&K Apprentice Merit List PDF

The JK Bank Apprentice Result contains the details of candidates who have been provisionally selected in the online examination. Candidates should carefully check all the information to confirm their selection status. Check the details below.

  • Candidate Roll Number
  • Advertisement Number
  • Name of the Recruitment
  • Qualification Status
  • Score Achieved
  • Details of the Next Selection Stages

What After JK Bank Apprentice Result 2026?

Candidates whose names appear in the JK Bank Apprentice Result 2026 will be called for the next stages of the selection process. They must first appear for Document Verification (DV) to confirm their eligibility. After that they will have to qualify the Medical Examination. Candidates who successfully clear all these stages will be engaged as Apprentices in the Jammu & Kashmir Bank under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

JK Bank Apprentice Result FAQs

Q. When was JK Bank Apprentice written exam 2026 held?

Ans: The Jammu & Kashmir Bank Apprentice Written Exam 2026 was held on 31st May 2026.

Q. When is J&K Bank Apprentice Result 2026 released?

Ans: The JK Bank Apprentice Result 2026 is released on 1st August 2026.

Q. How many vacancies have been announced for JK Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

Ans: A total of 614 apprentice vacancies have been announced for 2026 recruitment.

Q. What if i qualify for JK Bank Apprentice written exam?

Ans: Candidates who qualify for J&K Bank Apprentice exam will be called for the document verification round.

Q. Where can i download the JK Bank Apprentice Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates can download the JK Bank Result from official IBPS website.
